headline: Public hearings on a Notice of Intent at 19 Appaloosa Drive and two continued filings at 1-27 Independence Drive and 11 Cross Street.
summary: Eric Michard filed a Notice of Intent for 19 Appaloosa Drive. The agenda also carries over two earlier filings, a stormwater permit, and seven violation or enforcement items, plus a discussion of abbreviated NOI instructions.
items: Notice of Intent for 19 Appaloosa Drive, filed by Eric Michard (DEP # 219-1327, MCC # 26-008)
Continued public hearing on an Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation for 1-27 Independence Drive, filed by SRH Colonial Village LLC (DEP File #219-1326)
Continued public hearing on a Notice of Intent for 11 Cross Street, filed by CROSSLD QOZB, LLC (DEP File #219-1320, MCC File #26-001)
Correction to Old Business item H: enforcement order number changed from MCC #26-001 to MCC #26-002
Stormwater Permit Application for 11 Cross Street, filed by CROSSLD QOZB, LLC (continued from 10/01/2026)
Notice of Violation #24-008 and Enforcement Order #25-001 for 25 Thayer Street (continued from 08/20/2026)
Notice of Violation #26-009 for 91 Lindberg Ave (continued from 9/03/26)
Notice of Violation #26-012 for 71 Lowell Blvd (continued from 9/03/2026)
Notice of Violation #26-005 for 60 Ames Street (continued from 10/15/26)
Notice of Violation #26-013 for 10 Summit Ave.
Notice of Violation #26-015 for 8 Collier Ave
Conservation Officer's report: discuss NOI abbreviated instructions
location: Searles Building, 2nd Floor Conference Room, 41 Pleasant Street, and via Zoom
